asset: DojoFX (cherry petals, river mist / spray / haze, water foam)
units: metres in the FBX (export_fbx kind=static); Unreal cm on import
provenance: Our own procedural work (Blender 5.2 headless). The sheets dojo_petals_ref / dojo_mist_ref are AI-generated look references: measured and traced (petal outline), no reference pixel is in any texture. Colour-neutral FX maps, lit in engine.

SprayBurst.method: Mantaflow FLIP liquid sim res 176 + droplet points + mist volume

import.petal_meshes: Static Mesh, Import Normals, Nanite OFF (tiny masked two-sided cards: Niagara mesh particles and small clusters), Generate Lightmap UVs OFF (UV1 shipped), collision none (Collision Complexity: no collision; Niagara uses its own GPU depth-buffer collision), Build Scale 1.0. Material slot 0 MI_DKF_Petal, drift slot 1 MI_DKF_PetalOld.
import.textures: sRGB ON for *_BC only. *_N: Normalmap, Flip Green OFF (DirectX already). *_ORM / *_M: Masks. *_SSS: Grayscale. *_SixWayP / *_SixWayN: Default (BC7), sRGB OFF, Mip Gen FromTextureGroup, Texture Group Effects, LOD Bias 1 on Medium/Low scalability (4096 -> 2048). T_DKF_Foam_*: Texture Group World, Wrap. Petal and decal textures: Clamp is NOT required (masked).
import.flipbook_layout: 8 x 8, frame 0 top-left, row-major: Niagara Sub UV 'Sub Image Size' (8, 8), linear over Normalized Age, Sub UV Blending ON (renderer) for the 64-frame life cycle.

M_DKF_Petal (master).shading: Two Sided Foliage (or Substrate Slab, Sub-Surface Type Two-Sided Wrap, as the pines)

graph.BaseColor: lerp(T_BackBC.rgb, T_BC.rgb, TwoSidedSign * 0.5 + 0.5) * Tint; Tint default (1,1,1); hue jitter: lerp(1, (1.0, 0.97, 0.99), ParticleRandom or PerInstanceRandom) (+-3 %)
graph.WPO: none (Niagara moves the particles; clusters are static)

instances.MI_DKF_PetalOld: T_DKF_PetalOld_BC (also as Back BC), _N, _ORM, _SSS; Transmission 0.35, BackTint (0.8, 0.8, 0.8) (browned, ~1 in 8 on the ground, ~1 in 14 in the air)

M_DKF_PetalScatterDecal.graph: Cell (0..3 scalar) picks one 2x2 atlas cell: UV = TexCoord * 0.5 + (fmod(Cell,2), floor(Cell/2)) * 0.5; BaseColor = BC.rgb, Opacity = BC.a * Fade, Normal = N, Roughness = ORM.g
M_DKF_PetalScatterDecal.decal_actor: size X/Y 35 cm (one cell = 0.35 m), projection depth 10 cm, random yaw; cells: 0 sparse, 1 medium, 2 dense drift, 3 strays. Use in stone-paver joints, on moss and on the raked gravel where meshes would z-fight; the SM_DKF_PetalDrift_* meshes for hero spots.

M_DKF_SixWaySprite (master).flags: Responsive AA off, Depth Fade 150 cm (soft particles), Translucency Pass: Before DOF, no velocity output
M_DKF_SixWaySprite (master).subuv: Particle SubUV node (8x8, blend ON) sampling BOTH SixWayP and SixWayN with the same UVs

lighting.sprite_basis: R = CameraRightVector, U = CameraUpVector, F = CameraForwardVector (camera-facing sprites)
lighting.light: Ls = (dot(L,R), dot(L,U), dot(L,F)); L = direction TO the sun (MPC_DKF_Sky.SunDirection, set from the Ultra Dynamic Sky directional light each tick), sun colour MPC_DKF_Sky.SunColor
lighting.formula: key = max(Ls.x,0)*P.r + max(-Ls.x,0)*N.r + max(Ls.y,0)*P.g + max(-Ls.y,0)*N.g + max(Ls.z,0)*P.b + max(-Ls.z,0)*N.b ; P.b is lit from BEHIND the sprite (backlight, the sheet's sunset glow), N.b from the camera side
lighting.emissive: SunColor * key * SunIntensity + SkyColor * (P.g*0.5 + N.b*0.3 + 0.2) * AmbientScale
lighting.cheap_fallback: Default Lit translucent, Translucency Lighting Mode Volumetric Per Vertex Directional, BaseColor = lerp(0.4, 1, P.g), Opacity = P.a

instances.MI_DKF_SprayBurst: T_DKF_SprayBurst_SixWay* (AmbientScale 0.6, a little Specular-like boost: key^0.8)

materials.M_DKF_Haze: Translucent unlit sprite / card: Opacity = T_DKF_Haze_M.r * Alpha(0.12-0.2) * DepthFade(300); Emissive = SunColor * (0.6*b + 0.4*g) + SkyColor*0.3 (G top-lit, B back-lit). 2:1 card.

MF_DKF_RiverFoam (for the Water plugin r.inputs: WorldPosition.xy, flow (Water body velocity / flow map), turbulence mask (velocity magnitude, rock proximity from the distance field, the rapids spline mask)
MF_DKF_RiverFoam (for the Water plugin r.graph: two samples of T_DKF_Foam_M.r panned along the flow with a half-period phase offset (flow-map blend), tiling 2.0 m; T_DKF_Foam_M.g at 0.6 m for close lace; B streaks stretched along the flow; foam = saturate((cov - (1 - turbulence)) * 3) ; BaseColor = lerp(water, (0.80, 0.82, 0.82), foam); Roughness lerp(0.05, 0.6, foam); Normal = BlendAngleCorrected(water N, T_DKF_Foam_N, foam); Opacity/refraction reduced under foam
MF_DKF_RiverFoam (for the Water plugin r.seamless: built on the torus (FFT noise + periodic Voronoi; the Voronoi half-period shift test is exact to 5e-15), so the tile has no seam

NS_DKF_PetalFall.renderer: Mesh renderer, meshes SM_DKF_Petal_A..F (weight 1 each) + SM_DKF_PetalOld_A (weight 0.45 ~ 1 in 14 in the air), Facing Mode Default, sort off, GPU sim
NS_DKF_PetalFall.spawn: global: box 60 x 60 m at 8-16 m above the terrace, 25-40 /s; per CherrySlot actor: sphere r 3 m centred 4.5 m up, 2-5 /s (canopy fall) + gust burst 40-80 on a wind event
NS_DKF_PetalFall.scale: mesh is real size (12.5-14.5 mm); uniform scale 1.0-1.4 (gameplay legibility)
NS_DKF_PetalFall.forces: Gravity -980 cm/s2 + Drag 3.0 (terminal ~1 m/s, the real petal fall speed), Curl Noise strength 80 cm/s freq 0.015, Wind from MPC (UDS wind dir) 60-160 cm/s
NS_DKF_PetalFall.rotation: initial orientation random; Mesh Rotation Rate random axis 120-420 deg/s (flutter), Rotational Drag 1.5
NS_DKF_PetalFall.collision: GPU Depth Buffer collision, Restitution 0, Friction 0.9, Rest after 0.2 s; resting petals fade (Scale Color alpha) over the last 4 s
NS_DKF_PetalFall.lighting: the petal material (Two Sided Foliage) gives the back-lit rim glow at the 9 deg sun
NS_DKF_PetalFall.scalability: spawn scale Epic 1.0 / High 0.6 / Medium 0.35 / Low 0.15; cull 70 m; max 6000 GPU particles

emitters.puff: MI_DKF_MistPuff sprites at rapids / rock impacts: 2-4 /s, lifetime 4-7 s, size 3-7 m, velocity up 20-50 cm/s + downstream 60-150 cm/s, rotation +-15 deg, alpha 0.25-0.45
emitters.wisp: MI_DKF_MistWisp along the river spline: 4-8 /s, lifetime 6-10 s, size (8-14) x (4-7) m, velocity downstream 80-200 cm/s + up 10-30, alpha 0.2-0.35

NS_DKF_RiverMist.cell_usage: measured: MistPuff content spans 0.76 x 0.48 of a cell (median 0.68 x 0.43), MistWisp 0.78 x 0.41: the visible mist is ~0.7 of the sprite width, so set Sprite Size ~1.4x the wanted mist width
NS_DKF_RiverMist.common: SubUV 8x8 linear over age, Sub UV Blending ON, camera facing (Face Camera Plane), sort view depth, Depth Fade 150-300 cm, local space off, bounds fixed; colour white (lit by the six-way material from the UDS sun)

NS_DKF_RapidSpray.burst: MI_DKF_SprayBurst (a Mantaflow surge-into-boulder splash: rises up the rock face, the sheet tears, falls, fades): 1 sprite every 0.8-1.8 s per boulder the current hits, placed just in front of the rock, size 1.5-3 m (the cell spans 1.3 sim m), lifetime 0.64-0.9 s (64 frames at 100 fps = 0.64 s real time), sprite pivot offset (0.5, 0.96): the water line is 4 % above the cell bottom; mirror (UV flip) half the spawns for variety
NS_DKF_RapidSpray.droplets: secondary GPU sprites 1-3 cm, white, Velocity-aligned, 60-150 per burst, cone 35 deg up, speed 250-450 cm/s, gravity, lifetime 0.6-0.9 s
NS_DKF_RapidSpray.mist: each burst spawns 1 MI_DKF_MistPuff at 40 % alpha (the sheet's spray-into-mist)

niagara.NS_DKF_RiverHaze: T_DKF_Haze_M on 20-40 x 8-12 m camera-facing sprites with the Z axis locked (Custom Alignment (0,0,1)), low over the water, lifetime 25-40 s, drift 20-50 cm/s downstream, alpha 0.12-0.2, fade with height (Depth Fade 300 cm)
